notes.subject: phela ya gagwe
notes.rationale: אף ke nko/sefahlogo, eupša e bolela bogale — phela ya Sepedi e swara moka mego ka bobedi

notes.subject: Rahabe
notes.rationale: רהב: leina la sehlabelo sa lewatle sa setšo goba leina la mohubedu; kgethollo ya diphetholelo — 'ba ba thusago Rahabe' kgathanong le 'ba ba matla go feta teo'

notes.subject: אלוה לא ישיב
notes.rationale: ga go kopanyi 'ge' — sepego sa Seheberu se bolela ka tsela e sa tsejwago gore Eloha ga a phaphaletša phela

translation: Eloha ga a phaphaletša phela ya gagwe; ba ba thusago Rahabe ba phafogile ka motlolong ga gagwe.
